{"answer": "The checkout page already includes a working payment button that is integrated with the existing checkout flow, so no code changes were needed.

What's in place:
- `web/index.html` has a `<button id="pay" type="button">Pay now</button>` inside the checkout form, plus a payment method `<select id="method">` (Card / Bank transfer) and an `aria-live` result paragraph for status feedback.
- `web/app.js` wires the button via `addEventListener("click", pay)`. The `pay()` handler reads the selected method, disables the button while processing, POSTs `{ cart, method }` to `/api/checkout`, and renders either the success message (`Payment <status>: $<amount> via <method>`) or an error message, re-enabling the button in `finally`.
